name: Isovalue Contour Surface Classification
definition: A classification procedure for rendering isovalue contour surfaces (e.g., electron density maps) by assigning opacity to voxels near a selected value $f_s$, with opacity falling off inversely proportional to the local gradient magnitude to maintain constant transition region thickness.
summary: Isovalue Contour Surface Classification renders surfaces by assigning opacity based on proximity to an isovalue, maintaining constant spatial width to prevent aliasing artifacts inherent in binary thresholding.
